messages.体力の減った敵をS3「何でも料理できるさ」で仕留める火力役。S2「しょ・が」は精: A damage dealer that finishes weakened enemies with S3 I Can Cook Anything. At high SP, S2 I.H. is her main tool for clashes and damage, while kills let her passive heal allies.
messages.S3「何でも料理できるさ」: 対象の失った体力の5%分ダメージ量が増加(最大20: **S3 — I Can Cook Anything**: Deals more damage equal to 5% of the HP the target has lost, up to 20. On Heads Hit, Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ each give the final Coin +10%, +5%, and +5% damage. Against Abnormalities, it refers to the HP of the part being attacked.
messages.S2「しょ・が」: 3コインでマッチ威力2~17/3~18。Ⅰコインで次のターン: **S2 — I.H.**: 3 Coins with Clash Power 2–17/3–18. Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Bind next turn, Coin Ⅱ inflicts 1/2/3 Bleed on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅲ inflicts 1/3/4 HP Healing Down next turn if the target has Bleed or Paralyze. Effective against self-healing enemies.
messages.バトルパッシブ「即席料理」(色欲×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵討伐時、体力が: **Combat passive — Rustle Up (5 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On defeating an enemy, heals 15 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest HP, once per turn. If she has Appetite, she spends all of it to increase the healing.
messages.渇き: S1「りょ・し」のⅡコイン的中時に1/2、S2の使用時に1を得る。即席料: **Appetite**: Gains 1/2 on Coin Ⅱ hit of S1 P.C. and 1 on using S2. It increases Rustle Up's healing.
messages.サポートパッシブ「芸術的な味」(色欲×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 誰が倒しても: **Support passive — Artistic Flavor (5 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When an enemy dies, no matter who defeated it, heals 15 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest HP, once per turn.
messages.序盤はS1・S2で削りながらマッチを取り、体力の減った敵にS3を当てて仕留める。: Early on, chip away with S1 and S2 while taking Clashes, then finish weakened enemies with S3. Each kill lets Rustle Up heal an ally, with more healing if she has Appetite. The passive requires 5 Lust Owned, but her only Lust skills are S3 and her Defense skill, so pairing her with Lust allies makes it easier to activate.
